preconditions.description: The input must be a list of strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) and len(name.split()) == 2 for name in reindeer_names)
preconditions.description: Each string in the list must be composed of exactly two words.

postconditions.description: The output must be a list of reindeer names sorted by their last names.

postconditions.expression: all(reindeer_names[i].split()[1] <= reindeer_names[i+1].split()[1] for i in range(len(reindeer_names)-1))
postconditions.description: The output must maintain the original order for reindeer with identical last names.
